snippet.title: Spirit- - Indie Surreal Horror Game
snippet.description:
You wander a strange alien vessel where a viewfinder exposes an alternate unseen parallel dimension.

Game is FREE from creator Modus Interactive on Itch.io
https://modus-interactive.itch.io/spirit-

Enjoyable? Yes, peaceful mood with odd visuals
Replayable? One-play
